title: Reviewer Methodology Contexts
description: Context states that affect reviewer judgment.

entries.title: Reviewer Comment
entries.description: A commentary note that does not become a finding.

entries.title: Possible Finding
entries.description: A candidate that might become a finding.

entries.title: Confirmed Finding
entries.description: A supported finding with enough evidence.

entries.title: Insufficient Evidence
entries.description: The current context does not support a conclusion.

entries.title: Need More Context
entries.description: Additional local or cross-scene context is needed.
